name: Meridian Ring
description: A single line of gold cantilevers off the finger, balanced by an unseen counterweight of mass on the interior band.

name: Corbel Cuff
description: Named for the architectural bracket, this cuff projects from the wrist in a single confident overhang.

name: Knight Pendant
description: The knight's silhouette abstracted into two planes of gold, suspended on a fine box chain.

name: Castle Band
description: A fortified silhouette worn low on the finger — strength read as ornament.

name: Plinth Earrings
description: Each earring rests on its own sculptural base, as if lit from below in a private gallery.

name: Frame Necklace
description: An empty frame at the throat — a deliberate space left for the wearer to complete.

name: Monolith Signet
description: A single unbroken plane of gold, cast heavy and left unornamented.

name: Massing Hoops
description: Hoops that thicken toward the base, distributing weight like a building's foundation.
